10 open-source Somfy projects built by reverse engineering

Open-source projects that exist because someone reverse engineered Somfy blinds and TaHoma. 6 of 10 had a commit in the last 12 months. Most-starred: ESPSomfy-RTS, iown-homecontrol, Somfy_Remote, Somfy_Remote_Lib, homebridge-tahoma.

  1. ESPSomfy-RTS★ 1,241 · slowing · C++

    Control Somfy RTS shades with an ESP32 and CC1101 radio

  2. iown-homecontrol★ 291 · slowing · C++

    Documentation and implementation of the io-homecontrol radio protocol (Velux, Somfy)

  3. Somfy_Remote★ 239 · dormant · C++

    Arduino sketch that emulates a Somfy RTS remote (rolling-code protocol)

  4. Somfy_Remote_Lib★ 160 · active · C++

    Emulates a Somfy RTS remote with a 433.42 MHz transmitter

  5. homebridge-tahoma★ 148 · active · TypeScript

    Homebridge plugin for Somfy TaHoma, Connexoon and Cozytouch via the Overkiz API

  6. python-overkiz-api★ 61 · active · Python

    Async client for the Overkiz platform (Somfy TaHoma, Atlantic, Hitachi)

  7. somfy-io-bridge★ 25 · active · C++

    ESPHome component for local control of Somfy io-homecontrol covers without a TaHoma box

  8. Tasmota-SomfyRTS★ 22 · active · Berry

    Tasmota Berry script to control Somfy RTS blinds

  9. SomfyIO_ESPHome_HomeAssistant★ 19 · dormant

    Automating Somfy io-homecontrol screens with ESPHome

  10. iohc-flipper★ 2 · active · C

    Flipper Zero app to sniff, pair and control io-homecontrol (Velux/Somfy) devices
